page_title: MNT 0-0 NIC | Montpellier v Nice 10/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+4' Jordan Ferri (Montpellier) commits a rough challenge and Hakim Ben El Hadj blows his whistle for a foul.
90+2' Substitution. Teji Savanier walks off the pitch and Kelvin Yeboah (Montpellier) comes on as a substitute.
90+2' The corner is swung in but Nice can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
90+1' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) picks up a pass and hits the ball towards goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Benjamin Lecomte.
89' Morgan Sanson (Nice) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
88' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Nice comes to nothing.
86' Francesco Farioli prepares a substitution. Melvin Bard is replaced by Romain Perraud (Nice).
85' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
84' That will be all from Khalil Fayad who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier).
83' Hakim Ben El Hadj blows his whistle as Sofiane Diop (Nice) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
82' The referee has issued a yellow card to Melvin Bard (Nice).
80' One of the players from Montpellier times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
79' Nice are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
78' Theo Sainte-Luce is substituted due to injury. Michel Der Zakarian gives a chance to Christopher Jullien (Montpellier).
78' Theo Sainte-Luce (Montpellier) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
77' Montpellier failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
75' Nice have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
74' The resulting set piece from Nice is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
71' Pablo Rosario (Nice) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
71' The whistle is blown for an infringement and Jean-Clair Todibo (Nice) receives a yellow card!
67' We are about to witness a subsitution. Sofiane Diop (Nice) for Jeremie Boga.
67' Francesco Farioli has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Evann Guessand (Nice) replacing Terem Moffi.
65' Nice can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
64' Terem Moffi (Nice) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
63' Jordan Ferri (Montpellier) is penalised for holding. Hakim Ben El Hadj signals a set piece.
62' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Montpellier was in an offside position.

61' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Montpellier are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
61' Great solo effort by Akor Adams (Montpellier) as he tries his luck with a shot from long range towards the roof of the net. Marcin Bulka is alert and makes a save.
60' Substitution. Badredine Bouanani is replaced by Gaetan Laborde (Nice).
58' Mousa Al Tamari (Montpellier) connects with a cross from out wide in the six-yard box, but only plants his header onto the left post.
57' Montpellier take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
57' Falaye Sacko (Montpellier) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Montpellier.
56' Montpellier seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
53' It wasn't the best example of how to strike the ball. Khephren Thuram (Nice) unleashed a first-time shot from the edge of the box that went high over the crossbar.
52' Theo Sainte-Luce (Montpellier) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
51' Wonderful movement by Nice. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
50' Jeremie Boga (Nice) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.

48' Montpellier slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
46' Theo Sainte-Luce (Montpellier) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Marcin Bulka intercepts the ball.
46' Jeremie Boga (Nice) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' 1 additional min. will be played.
45+1' Hakim Ben El Hadj shows a yellow card to Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) for his blatant foul.
45' Khephren Thuram (Nice) skips perfectly past challenges but misdirects his shot from the edge of the box. The ball flies a few yards wide of the right post.
44' Nice seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
42' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Nice.
41' Jeremie Boga (Nice) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
36' A long pass, executed by Joris Chotard (Montpellier), missed the precision to reach his teammates.
34' A mistake by the defender lets in Badredine Bouanani (Nice), but his first-time shot flies a whisker past the left post.
34' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Marcin Bulka, who smothers the ball.
33' A cross from a corner kick by Montpellier is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.

32' Akor Adams (Montpellier) produces a great solo run in the middle of the field, zig-zags through the opposition's defence at full speed and fires a powerful strike that crashes against the right post. What a chance!
32' Jeremie Boga (Nice) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
31' Pablo Rosario (Nice) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
28' Wonderful movement by Nice. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
26' Hakim Ben El Hadj couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Jordan Ferri (Montpellier) and blew his whistle.
25' Falaye Sacko (Montpellier) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.

23' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Nice are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
19' A cross from Morgan Sanson (Nice) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
18' Mousa Al Tamari (Montpellier) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
15' The ball spins out to Teji Savanier (Montpellier) and his swerving volley from the edge of the box flashes just over the bar.
14' Akor Adams (Montpellier) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
12' Khalil Fayad (Montpellier) sends a long ball in, but Marcin Bulka comfortably gathers the ball.
11' An attempted cross from Mousa Al Tamari (Montpellier) is cleared.
9' Badredine Bouanani (Nice) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
7' Jeremie Boga (Nice) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
5' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Pablo Rosario (Nice) is given a yellow card.
4' Dangerous play by Morgan Sanson (Nice). Hakim Ben El Hadj blows his whistle for a foul.
1' Nice are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.

The players are on the pitch and Nice will have the kick-off.
